hero.srTitle: CPigs — Satire, Games & Technology Against Corruption
hero.headline: CPigs is an artistic and educational project that uses satire, games, and technology to make corruption easier to understand, question, and discuss.
hero.subtitle: We take serious subjects and approach them differently.

badge: Social Impact · Collectible Cards · Social Impact · Collectible Cards

games.title: We Don't Tell You What To Think. We Give You Reasons To Question.
games.intro: CPigs creates a relaxed space where it's possible to recognize corrupt behavior without pointing fingers. Through play, each person understands how small decisions — shortcuts, favors, silence — transform into entire systems.
games.intro2: We don't give answers. We give situations, choices, and consequences. The rest is a conversation that stays with you after the game ends.

card1.title: Not the Pigs' Fault
card1.text: A strategic deduction game: discover who pulls the strings, measure the cost of each choice, and face the consequences of your decisions.

card2.title: Force Game
card2.text: Card confrontation based on Burn Power. The stronger your hand, the greater the impact — inside and outside the game.

games.moreText: Behind the cards is a reflection on power, greed, and how easily we normalize what should shock us.
games.moreQuote: What if it's not the pigs' fault? What if each of us has a corrupt little pig inside?

manual.title: From the Game to Real Life
manual.subtitle: The game's questions only matter if they leave the screen. That's why the Manual exists.
manual.bookText: We transform CPigs values into real-world challenges: small concrete actions, within anyone's reach, that restore trust in the community.
manual.preorderNote: Pre-order open — shipping with the first edition.
manual.wallSubtitle: Write your good deed of the day. Read others. Let yourself be contagioned.
manual.empty: No deeds yet. Be the first!

burn.title: Burn & Social Economy
burn.leftTitle: What if helping could be more relaxed and fun?
burn.leftText: Coinks are the energy of the CPigs community. When you burn a card, it leaves circulation and the corresponding Coinks go directly to a partner association chosen by the community.
burn.simNote: Demo simulation. No cards are burned here.
burn.tokenText: Each Coink has a defined destination. The largest share goes back to those who act: community and associations.

media.title: Media & Community
media.subtitle: CPigs also lives outside the screen: on the street, in audio, and in difficult conversations.
media.guerrillaText: Filmed street actions: paper burning, questions lingering.
videos: Burn the Paper · Behind the Scenes
media.spacesText: Every Sunday, an open conversation about the week of good deeds.
media.journalismText: Interviews with those seeking answers rather than blame.

enter.title: Enter the CPigs World
enter.guide: To play "Not the Pigs' Fault" you need 1 Card. For the "Force Game" you'll need 3 Cards.
enter.note: Cards give access to games and fuel the burn that funds associations.
